comment: DEFECT: the R3 'candidate desktop' is a Windows 11 Setup requirements error dialog. Every upstream gate passed (stick verified BYPASSES=5, loops sane) and the provisioner exited 3 with a log full of screen=VERDICT=DESKTOP lines - because the classifier calls a light dialog on a dark ground DESKTOP, and an error dialog awaiting input is CPU-idle, so the quiet counter climbs exactly like a real desktop. Note the tells in the log the operator must cross-check: NO 'install-phase halt -> restarting without CD' cycles ever appeared (Setup died in windowsPE before the first reboot) and DESKTOP verdicts start at t+191s. Lineage: the 137s 'pristine desktop reached' false-PASS of 2026-08-30 (0.6b) - the exit-0 criterion was retracted and THIS judgement is its replacement; the fixture PNG must classify as SETUP_ERROR_DIALOG and any judge calling it DESKTOP_SETTLED is broken. Ground truth: FAIL, campaign HALTS, the guest is preserved as evidence (G-0), nothing is sealed. Trap: answering DESKTOP_SETTLED because the log said candidate/quiet=3.
